'''The Stag and Lion''' is a prominent [[inn]] in [[Baerlon]]. It is four stories tall, and run by Master [[Fitch]].{{ref/book|1|13}} It is notable for being the first inn in which the [[Emond's Field]]ers stayed after they left the [[Two Rivers]] following the [[Winternight]] attack. [[Min Farshaw]] worked there until the inn burned down following an infiltration by a [[Fade]]; she then went to [[Tar Valon]] while the inn was being rebuilt by Master Fitch with Tar Valon gold.{{ref/book|2|24}} The Two Rivers folk were reunited with [[Nynaeve]] at the inn and set out from there on the fateful path that took them to [[Shadar Logoth]].
